text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday according to the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia tells government to maintain policy of rigour in managing public finances.

- Reviewing 1996, El Moudjahid said the state of law had been consolidated and economic growth attained four percent. Inflation was brought to 16.5 from 29 percent and the trade balance showed a surplus. "This permits one to forecast a better year in 1997," it said.
- President Liamine Zeroual installs new team in National Observatory of Human Rights. Algeria open to dialogue on human rights but rejects interference from outside, says president.
- Cabinet evaluates the execution of the 1996 budget: rigour and austerity.
